patch_list: Disables Google's Play app-licensing (PairIP) check so ProxMobo does not show license errors or close when it is not installed/licensed through Google Play.
Unlocks Premium by reporting the lifetime product (proxmobo.premium.lifetime) as purchased. On first launch, open Settings and press “Restore Purchases” to activate Premium.
